cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Not About Who Lost
cards.instruction: Keep the conversation focused on rules, effort, or next steps instead of the result that embarrasses you.

mechanism: Mistake a confidently stopping marshal for a runner, then turn a failed race into a discussion of pacing and who to follow next time.
confusable: Not simply excusing fatigue: the copied stop and refusal to acknowledge mistaken identification must determine A's next plan.
comparison: Race participant and companion choose a future guide, unlike cooperative quiz submission rehearsal.
